Class ContainerDisplay

java.lang.Object
net.minecraft.world.inventory.AbstractContainerMenu
org.cyclops.colossalchests2.inventory.ContainerGhostSettings
org.cyclops.colossalchests2.inventory.ContainerDisplay
public class ContainerDisplay extends ContainerGhostSettings
The settings of a Display wall: for each face on the outside of the chest, the item it shows and what it shows. Buttons are numbered by face and option, see getButton(Direction, DisplayOption).
